title: The river from the Mỹ Cảnh — patrol boat TD.9 at the quay
description: From the deck, past a diagonal brace: a grey naval patrol craft with the hull marking TD.9 lies at a stone quay, mast and lookout ring above her awning frames, other small craft beyond; across the wide river a far shore of red-roofed warehouses and palms under a cumulus sky. "This is the river from the My Cahn. The TD9 is a Vietnamese patrol boat."
researchNotes: Larry's caption of 2026-09-05 (giscus-vn-0089-c18308137.json), which puts the camera on the floating restaurant and settles the survey's Saigon-or-Nha-Trang question in favour of Saigon. The hull code is legible, and Vietnamese Navy small-craft designations of the period are documented — TD-series hulls should identify the vessel's type and station, which would corroborate the mooring from the naval side. Not yet searched; a clean lead for a records session.
